lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, with the highest intensity nodes concentrated in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal blob rows at approximately 90-degree angles, creating a grid-like coordinate system of high-intensity anchor points across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and a localized shadow-cast on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Dense distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the dorsal fin silhouette, primarily clustered along the anterior margin and middle surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch and jagged tissue loss on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae individuals clustered near the ventral midline and sub-pectoral region; distinct cluster of high-intensity micro-spots on the proximal dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
